instruction.text: Lies dir den Text durch und beantworte die Fragen. Mehrere Antworten können richtig sein.

atoms.text: The Science Museum is located on Exhibition Road in South Kensington. It is near the Natural History Museum and the Victoria and Albert Museum. The museum is open seven days a week, and it opens at 10am and closes at 6pm daily. Entry to the museum is free. However, free tickets have to be pre-booked online and children under 12 need to be accompanied by an adult.

b: ++The Victoria and Albert Museum is nearby.
The Imperial War Museum is nearby.

atoms.a: What are the opening hours of the museum?
b: It is open from Monday to Friday and is closed on Saturdays and Sundays.
